svg.title: paceline in its different states
svg.desc: Fresh day, Working through the day, Most of the budget used, Over budget, Week forecast to run out, Session running low, The last day, Agent job in progress, Verbose, counting down, fast mode, Both limits, as the Go line.
svg.text: The day starts with its budget, 14 points of the week; none of it is spent.
Spent points drain the bar; green while there is room.
Yellow past 70% of the budget, red past 85%.
The overage turns red, and tomorrow's budget shrinks to match.
At the current pace the week ends before it resets.
With the session segment on, its reset time becomes out ~10:15am, in red.
The whole week left is the budget.
A planned run shows weighted progress, and the context warning appears at 70%.
verbose and countDirection in paceline.json; fast mode from settings.
Both limits, as the Go line
"limits": "both" skips the forecast and shows the session too.
